title: Money problems: profit, loss, discount and VAT

blocks.content: Buying and selling is full of maths. Profit, loss, discount and VAT all come down to adding to or taking away from a price.
Profit is how much MORE you sell for than it cost: profit = selling price - cost. A loss is when you sell for less than it cost.

steps: You buy a bag for $20 and sell it for $30.

blocks.prompt: You buy at $20 and sell at $30. Your profit is $___
blocks.rule: Profit = selling price - cost. A loss is cost - selling price when you sell for less.

blocks.content: VAT is a tax ADDED on to a price; a discount is taken OFF.

blocks.prompt: A $100 item with 10% VAT ($10) added costs $___
blocks.rule: VAT is added on to the price; a discount is taken off.

blocks.content: Sell for more than cost to profit; add VAT on, take a discount off. It is all adding and subtracting from a price. Let's practise!
